label: s1_side02_0030_camera_01
text: Good... Yeah, just like that![VAR 0x0114(0046)]

label: s1_side02_0030_camera_02
text: OK, now give me...cute![VAR 0x0114(0046)]

text: Call out to her

label: s1_side02_0030_select_02
text: Keep watching

label: s1_side02_0030_camera_03
text: Yes, look at you, you clever thing! Lovely![VAR 0x0114(0046)]

label: s1_side02_0030_camera_04
text: Now hold that pose for just a sec... Yes! That’s\nmy little cutie pie![VAR 0x0114(0046)]

label: s1_side02_0030_camera_05
text: Wow, look at you! I didn’t even know you could\npull off that kind of expression! So photogenic![VAR 0x0114(0046)]

label: s1_side02_0030_camera_06
text: You’re just too adorable, you know that?! I could\neat you right up![VAR 0x0114(0046)]

label: s1_side02_0030_camera_07
text: What’s this?! An extra serving of cuteness, just for\nme?! Don’t mind if I do![VAR 0x0114(0046)]

label: s1_side02_0030_camera_08
text: More! I need more! Someone get me some extra\nstorage—and a napkin, too![VAR 0x0114(0046)]

label: s1_side02_0030_dog_01
text: Growawan!

label: s1_side02_0030_camera_09
text: Oh! Hey, partner! You made it![VAR 0x0114(0046)]

label: s1_side02_0030_camera_10
text: How long have you been standing there? You\nweren’t, uh, listening in on all that stuff I—\r\nNope! Don’t want to know! Forget I asked![VAR 0x0114(0046)]

label: s1_side02_0030_camera_11
text: I can’t help myself when I see adorable Pokémon\nlike that—I just had to snap a couple shots![VAR 0x0114(0046)]

label: s1_side02_0030_camera_12
text: Aaanyway, it’s right around this part of the\nforest where people have supposedly seen\r\nthe Bloodmoon Beast.[VAR 0x0114(0046)]

label: s1_side02_0030_camera_13
text: Curiously, all the sightings have been on [VAR 0xFF00(0006)]nights[VAR 0xFF00(0000)]\n[VAR 0xFF00(0006)]with heavy fog[VAR 0xFF00(0000)].[VAR 0x0114(0046)]

label: s1_side02_0030_camera_14
text:
In fact, I’ve heard that all kinds of unusual
Pokémon appear on foggy nights.\c
I’m sure that the Bloodmoon Beast is one of
them—it’s gotta be...[VAR 0x0114(0046)]

label: s1_side02_0030_system_01
text: *rustle rustle rustle*

text: Oh, is that my little cutie pie, back for another\nphoto shoot?[VAR 0x0114(0046)]

text: Owww... That really surprised me.[VAR 0x0114(0046)]

label: s1_side02_0030_camera_19
text: My camera’s OK, though. Thanks, partner.[VAR 0x0114(0046)]

label: s1_side02_0030_dog_03
text: Bow-ow!

label: s1_side02_0030_camera_20
text: And thanks to you too, of course.[VAR 0x0114(0046)]

label: s1_side02_0030_camera_21
text: I feel a bit bad for that Ariados. It probably\nwasn’t expecting to see humans out here.\r\nI bet it only attacked because it was surprised.[VAR 0x0114(0046)]

text: We should set up a tent! That’ll let the Pokémon\nknow we’re here and help them get used to us![VAR 0x0114(0046)]
